`plotplot redact` reads all of standard input, writes the redacted text to standard output, exits 0. `--tally` also writes one JSON object to standard error: {"total": n, "by": {"entropy": n, "format": n, "prefix": n, "uri": n, "connection": n, "keyvalue": n}}. - The face in src/cli.rs (a Redact variant with a --tally flag) and its dispatch in src/main.rs, reading stdin as bytes and refusing non-UTF-8 with exit 1 and empty stdout.
- Unit tests in src/redact.rs that load the fixture file, decode each row, and assert text and tally per row, so `cargo test` holds the contract without the shell test.
